datasets.title: Denmark Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 3.7 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 79% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 1 year, 5 months ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 5% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['building'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en building building:levels building:materials addr:full addr:housenumber addr:street addr:city office source name:da This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) using the Raw Data API. The dataset represents approximately 79% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 1 year 5 months and 5% of buildings updated within the last 6 months.
